notes.title: Embarking on New Horizons: The Latest Chapter in Desert Revenant
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

As we journey deeper into the vast expanses of Elmyr, our commitment to delivering an experience that not only meets but exceeds your expectations remains unwavering. In the spirit of transparency and community, we find it essential to share an update on the horizon of enhancements we've been meticulously crafting for Desert Revenant.

[h2]An Update on Our Journey[/h2]

In our last communication, we promised a horizon of updates coming soon, aimed at transforming the Desert Revenant experience. We're thrilled to report that our development journey has been fruitful, unveiling more opportunities to refine and expand the game than we initially anticipated.

As this major update is drawing closer, we want to assure you that our focus remains on delivering an update that not only meets but exceeds your expectations in every way. This means taking the extra time to polish, refine, and test every new feature, ensuring that when we do step into this new chapter, it's together, with a game that's better than ever.

[h2]Focused Enhancements and Additions[/h2]

Our commitment to enhancing your journey through Elmyr has led us to dive deeper into several key areas:

[list]
[*] [b]UI and UX Refinements:[/b] Building on the promise of a UI overhaul, we've further refined the interface and the overall game pacing. Our goal is to make every interaction in the game more intuitive and enriching, allowing you to fully immerse in the strategic depth and storytelling without any distractions.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Starter Deck Evolution:[/b] The starter decks for the Seer and Leper have been meticulously balanced and enriched, offering an engaging and smooth introduction for newcomers, while retaining depth and strategy for veterans. New cards and adjusted synergies await to make your initial steps into Elmyr as exciting as the challenges that lie ahead.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Game Pacing:[/b] We've taken a comprehensive approach to improve the game's pacing, ensuring that every moment is filled with meaningful decisions, challenges, and rewards. From combat flows to map exploration, your journey through Elmyr will feel more cohesive and rewarding.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Expanded Content:[/b] New challenges, enemies, and surprises have been woven into the fabric of Desert Revenant. These additions are designed to test your strategies and adaptability, offering fresh adventures and rewards that make each playthrough unique.
[/list]

[h2]Forward Together[/h2]

The journey through the desert is as much yours as it is ours. Every step we take is guided by your feedback, enthusiasm, and the shared passion for adventure that makes this community so extraordinary.

We're excited to unveil all the enhancements and new experiences we've been working on, and we look forward to announcing more details, including patch notes and a preview of what's to come, in the near future.

Your support, patience, and engagement are the cornerstones of Desert Revenant's ever-expanding universe. Together, we're not just playing a game; we're creating a world teeming with danger, discovery, and untold treasures.

Thank you for being a part of this journey. The best adventures in Elmyr still lie ahead, and we can't wait to explore them with you.

With gratitude,
The Kreationware team.

notes.title: A New Dawn for Desert Revenant: Major Updates Incoming!
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

After a period of intense development and countless hours behind the scenes, we're thrilled to finally share the horizon of updates set to transform Desert Revenant.
Our journey through the desert has unearthed new challenges, rewards, and changes designed to enrich your experience and test your resolve. Here’s a glimpse of what’s coming:


[h2]1. UI Overhaul[/h2]

We've revamped the User Interface for a clearer, more immersive Field of View. Expect a more intuitive and visually appealing interface that enhances your navigation and strategic decisions.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740852317917806685/1204277130330902639/before_after-09_03.png?ex=65d4257a&is=65c1b07a&hm=1c76d264cf7096fc34e0409a7b64bdab3016513624c9836312e0c425107af097&[/img]
[i]Battle Log Revamped: Enhanced for superior readability and visibility.[/i]


[h2]2. Starter Card Changes[/h2]

Both the Seer and Leper will greet new players with updated starter decks. These changes are aimed at smoothing the learning curve and providing a more engaging entry point into our world.


[h2]3. Curse Additions and Hard Modes[/h2]

Dare to face the desert's curse? We've not only added new Curses but have also introduced Hard Modes, each uniquely tailored to the theme of their respective locations. These challenges bring a fresh layer of strategy and replayability to your adventures, offering new rewards.
This system ensures that while the challenges are thematically distinct, the experience remains rewarding and engaging.


[h2]4. Enemies and Elite Challenges[/h2]

Brace yourselves for the Emberlord Ifrit, a formidable new Elite enemy within the Temple of the Sun, and confront Humababa, a cunning Mini-boss, in the shadowy depths of the Temple of the Moon region. Additionally, the Soul of Desolation has ascended to an Elite challenge, promising complex encounters and worthy spoils for those brave enough to face it.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1204258224216350780/Ifrit.gif?ex=65d413de&is=65c19ede&hm=67c29b777bf248348047a0c538677313d29466b852a9b4cc22a71298770bb50c&[/img]
[i]Emberlord Ifrit: A fierce new Elite enemy ignites the battlefield with unparalleled power.[/i]


[h2]5. Map System Redesign[/h2]

Explore like never before with our completely overhauled Map System. The new design eliminates small maps, offering a streamlined and immersive exploration experience.



[h2]6. New Playable Map: Eye of the Storm[/h2]

We are introducing 'Eye of the Storm', the latest map to unfold in the vast expanse of Desert Revenant. Face off against a roster of new adversaries, battle through new enemies, confront the formidable Lord of Cyclones, and navigate interactions with unique NPCs who offer exclusive borrowed powers. This map is a crucible of adventure, testing your strategy with every step.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1204257609775849502/EyeoftheStorm2_copie.jpg?ex=65d4134c&is=65c19e4c&hm=dd4e87742ab6f3ac02563e764fdf9115da6f96ebe17c6553a981afcdf4b94469&[/img]
[i]Discover the Eye of the Storm: Navigate new roads and face fresh challenges on our expansive new map[/i]


[h2]7. Enhanced Rewards System[/h2]

We're amplifying the thrill of exploration with an enriched rewards system. During your runs through the desert, you'll encounter more diverse and substantial rewards, enhancing your strategic options and customization possibilities.


[h2]8. Genesis Phase Update[/h2]

Start your runs with enhanced choices. Now pick two options from blessings, previous run cards, special genesis blessings, or a new mulligan feature, for a tailored beginning. 


[h2]9. Balance Tweaks, Bug Fixes, and More[/h2]

We've implemented significant balance adjustments, made the game faster and more intuitive, and squashed pesky game-breaking bugs. Expect a smoother, more balanced journey through the desert.


[h2]10. Artistic Enhancements[/h2]

Our artists have been hard at work updating assets across the board, breathing new life into the desert and its inhabitants.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740852317917806685/1204261404790620190/before_after-09.png?ex=65d416d4&is=65c1a1d4&hm=2388a2a98e1b687ab3a24523a5395ff057752f69167d78b8be3e38aec46a158e&[/img]
[i]Transformation in character design, with a clearer, more intuitive display of HP, buffs, debuffs, and passives for enhanced visibility and gameplay clarity."[/i]


This upcoming update marks a new era for Desert Revenant, crafted with love, feedback, and the adventurous spirit of our community. We can't wait for you to experience the enhancements firsthand. Prepare to embark on a renewed quest through the desert of Elmyr, where danger, discovery, and treasures abound.
Stay tuned for detailed patch notes and launch dates. Your support and feedback have been instrumental in this journey, and we're excited to step into this new chapter together.

notes.title: Desert Revenant - Rise of the Arcane Tyrant - Patch 1.3.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Rise of the Arcane Tyrant update is out! Get ready to battle it out against Hand of Miracles in World's Edge, a new and very exciting region!

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635231793922189/PatchNotes.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635231563231393/NewFeatures.png[/img]

[h2][b]Introducing World's Edge![/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] New playable map called "World's Edge"
[*] Introducing new unique regular enemies, a new mini-boss: The Anqa, and the new boss: Hand of Miracles!
[*] Five new NPCs, each wielding captivating borrowed powers that promise endless enjoyment!
[*] Diverging from the customary Elite battles, World's Edge offers an intriguing puzzle challenge named "Towerwinds." Engage in a captivating board game showdown against Hand of Miracles, blending challenge and enjoyment in one exciting experience!
[/list]



[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126646210355286087/BalanceUpdates.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Contagion's first upgrade now applies 6 Plague instead of 3.
[*] Slightly reduced the chance where the Realm Ripper would target itself.
[/list]



[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635238819377193/BugFixes.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where clicking on the talent option in a successive manner would allow the player to get the same talent twice.
[*] The "Combatant Odyssey" achievement now works as intended.
[*] Fixed a bug where a character state above the passive bar would get hidden after inspecting the character.
[*] Fixed a bug where having the "Irrepressible Magic" blessing would still allow a card banished by "Divine Will" to be sent to the Banish Pile.
[*] Fixed a bug where having "Everlasting Bond" along with the "Armament" talent would give the player additional Mana when equipping Weapons.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Realm Ripper would not target the player if inflicted by Silence effects.
[*] Fixed a bug where Spoils of War would not trigger against an enemy that has the Rebirth passive.

[/list]



As ever, to stay informed about the game's latest developments or to share your valuable feedback, we invite you to join our Discord community and we encourage you to continue contributing to the Steam Discussions forums. Your insights are invaluable and play a pivotal role in shaping the ongoing development of the game. And now, enjoy exploring World's Edge!

notes.title: Desert Revenant - Patch 1.2.2 update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The goal of this minor patch is to address some bugs.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635231793922189/PatchNotes.png[/img]


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635230925684776/QualityofLife.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The keywords will now be displayed on the right side of the card when four cards are presented on the reward screen.
[/list]


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635238819377193/BugFixes.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the screen could black out at the end of the run.
[*] Fixed a bug where the description of unlocked curses would not appear at the end of the run.
[*] Fixed a bug where where clicking on the map node was possible even while being at the Wish Jinn.
[*] Fixed a bug where directly loading into the map would still play the Main Menu music.
[*] Rectified an issue where players could purchase a card from the Merchant that was intended to be locked.
[*] Fixed a bug where the newly introduced Curses would not show up on the Leadeboard.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Realm Ripper would be affected by the "Wicked Grounds" affix.
[*] Fixed the Moon King's AI. It cannot use Lunar Burst outside of Coalescence even if 8+ Curses are picked.
[*] Fixed some typos in the Battle log and in the Character Inspect page.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Absorption Shield of the Realm Breaker's Endless Rift would remain on the battlefield even if the owner of the Absorption Shield was defeated.
[*] Upgraded Weapon cards will now correctly be displayed in the Combatant Holster.
[*] Fixed a bug where Reveal Weakness' second upgrade would apply "Weak Point" throughout the entire battle.
[*] Fixed a bug where Netherstep would apply Portal Fatigue for the remainder of the battle.
[*] Fixed a bug where summoning Ghostly Apparition while having the Dark Aura Talent would apply negative Resilience on the Ghostly Apparition.

[/list]


We appreciate your constant feedback and we're doing our best to create the best possible experience while playing Desert Revenant.
We just wanted you to know that we have a major patch coming out soon with quite a lot of new and exciting content! 
We are committed to prioritizing enhancements in performance, UI, and the addition of a plethora of SFX cues throughout the game!

notes.title: 1.2.1 Hotfix updates
notes.content:
[b]Hello again everyone! Here are the latest changes for the new Hotfix[/b]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635231793922189/PatchNotes.png[/img]


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126646210355286087/BalanceUpdates.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Precise Assault now applies 1 Focus to the Combatant when used.
[*] Guillotine's damage is now doubled for every time it is added to the Draw Pile instead of doubling on each use.
[*] Vigilant Strike now doubles the Armor gained if the Combatant already has Armor.
[*] Shatter no longer removes a debuff from the enemy when used.
[*] Shadow Incarnate is now a State instead of a buff.
[*] Damage from Root can no longer be mitigated by Armor.
[/list]


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635230669844591/UserInterface.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The battle log is now available to see as Death Recap after a defeat on the Results Screen.
[*] It is now possible by left clicking to preview the cards and their upgrades in a larger format in the Deck and in the Spellbook.
[/list]


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635238559318066/ArtUpdates.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Platforms in the battle environments have now their textures improved.
[*] Improved the textures of the Combatant's Holster.
[*] Card glow colors have been improved and unified.
[*] Added a new particle effect for the Lightning Bomb spell.
[*] Improved the visuals of the locked cards in the Spellbook.
[*] Improved the textures of the information boxes.
[*] Improved the Dunestalker's textures.
[/list]


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635230925684776/QualityofLife.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added a new glow for cards that have their Amplify condition satisfied, which makes them much easier to track during a battle.
[*] Increased the size of the text in various parts of the game and added a more dynamic font in cards.
[*] Increased the size of the enchantments during combat.
[*] The description of keywords are now displayed in the outcomes of the Desert Encounters.
[*] Added a reminder message when starting a new run about the Reputation Points resetting.
[*] It is no longer possible to obtain a Neutral card when transforming during Desert Encounters.
[*] It is no longer possible to obtain a Neutral card in Spells of the Past.
[/list]


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635238819377193/BugFixes.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug where Arcane Fulmination and Fierce Demolition would not display the correct number of Chaos cards used and Weapon damage dealt.
[*] Fixed a bug where there was a small chance of obtaining a "Corrupted card" that could hinder a run during the Desert Encounters.
[*] Fixed a system bug where the game would launch at 1920p instead of the resolution set by the player or by the default screen size.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Mana Cost of a card obtained by Omen of Origins would be set to its default value when the Cursed Treasures curse is active.
[*] Fixed a bug where the tooltip of the upgraded Wish Jinn and Oasis from the Scholar Reputation tree would not be updated.
[*] Fixed a bug where it would be possible to click on the Dialogue node for Borrowed Powers even when going through an adjacent path.
[*] Fixed a bug where taking the Divine Will blessing would not display a card to purge in the beginning of Combat which would stop the player from continuing the battle.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Mind Reach talent would not add an extra stack to the Dominate Mind debuff.
[*] Fixed a bug where Beacon of Honor would trigger every 2 turns after the initial trigger of 8 turns.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where the Spirit Loop buff would remain on the Soothsayer even after its target was defeated.
[*] Fixed a bug where transforming the Dunestalker into a Realm Wisp would hide the Realm Wisp's texture for a turn.
[*] Fixed a bug where Herald of Eminence's Leap of Faith would not trigger if the Combatant was destroyed without taking damage.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Pyrokinesis values would sometimes not be well translated.
[*] Fixed a bug where Legacy of Power would heal for 1 instead of 7 and would heal for every card cast after the first trigger.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Arcane Deluge debuff would not take into consideration upgraded Arcane spells.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Jinn of Flames would sometimes use Inferno on its first turn.
[/list]


Some extra minor bugs and localization fixes were also undertaken.

Thanks again for all your feedback and looking forward to the next update!

notes.title: Desert Revenant - Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Greetings everyone![/b] [b]This is our biggest update yet and we want to first of all thank everyone for the invaluable feedback that we've been getting to help us shape the game into its best version yet.[/b]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635231793922189/PatchNotes.png[/img]



[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635231563231393/NewFeatures.png[/img]

[h3]We are thrilled to announce the addition of a new playable character: [b]The Combatant![/b] Prepare for intense battles and exciting gameplay as the Combatant joins the fray.[/h3]

The Combatant brings a truly unique experience to the realm of turn-based strategy games with innovative mechanics:

[list]
[*] Weapon Swapping: The Combatant excels at adapting to any situation with her weapon swapping ability. Switch between a shield for defense, dual-wielded weapons for offense, or mighty greatswords for devastating strikes.
[*] Weapon Enchantments: The Combatant's has the prowess to empower her weapons with enchantments that enhance her spellcasting abilities.
[*] Different Forms: The Combatant has shape shifting abilities, gaining powerful perks in each form.
[*] Critical Strikes: The Combatant has the unique ability to deal Critical Strike damage, dealing devastating damage.

[/list]


[h3]Introducing the Valley of Thunders: Unleash Your Powers in a New Realm Ruled by Two Thunders![/h3]

The Valley of Thunders, a brand-new area that lies under the dominion of Two Thunders. Venture into this realm and confront a host of thrilling additions, including new enemies, NPCs with borrowable powers, a new mini-boss: the Nephilim, and an elite adversary known as the Asag, ruler of the underworld.




[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126635230455922738/GameplayChanges.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Expanded the Reputation tree of the Sultanate and Scholars with 3 new unlockable points.
[*] Desert Encounters now yield better rewards and can also offer blessings.
[*] Enhanced the rewards system after defeating elite, mini-boss, and boss encounters, increasing the likelihood of obtaining higher-quality and rarer cards.
[*] Added 4 new challenging curses to elevate the difficulty of the runs even further.
[*] Curses now come with tier bonuses, rewarding you with extra score upon completing a run with a specific number of curses. Additionally, you can unlock powerful Genesis blessings by being victorious while afflicted with curses for an unparalleled advantage in your future runs.
[*] Reduced the score required to unlock new cards.
[*] Some talents are now unlockable through score.
[/list]



[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/740851354200965190/1126646210355286087/BalanceUpdates.png[/img]

[h3]General changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Channel is now a state instead of a buff. It will not be affected anymore by Darkness and similar effects.
[*] Darkness cannot stack for more than 1 turn at a time.
[*] Reduced the damage of Image of Darkness by 1 (Jinn of Darkness ability), but it can no longer be mitigated by Armor and damage reduction effects.
[*] Soul Bomb (Soul of Desolation ability) now deals 8 damage when it expires (Was 10 previously)
[*] Suntouched (Extra enemy passive) will now apply 2 Burn instead of 3.
[*] Realm’s Ripper Nether Aura will now dissipate from all its targets once the Realm Ripper is defeated.
[*] Optimized the targeting algorithm of Sila, resulting in a reduced chance for her to inadvertently target herself.
[*] Jinn of Flames no longer uses Inferno on his first turn.
[*] Reduced the Mana cost of Magic Lamp and Gleaming Gems by 1.
[*] Cycle of Agony now applies Infect instead of Darkness.
[*] Divine Scroll: Ignite is now a targeted ability.
[*] Slightly reduced Duelist HP when faced on the first map.
[/list]


[h3]Leper spells balance changes[/h3]

[list]

notes.title: 1.1.4 patch notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Excited to share the new patch notes with you all. We're still working hard for our next major update that is coming soon and we're still going strong when it comes to optimizing the performance in the game as well.

[h3]New Language[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added Simplified Chinese language to the game.
[/list]

[h3]Performance[/h3]

[list]
[*] Massively reduced the overall size of the game on the drive.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would sometimes slightly stutter during combat.
[*] Fixed an uncommon low FPS issue that would happen during long battles.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where rarity crystals would sometimes show on different cards after upgrading cards.
[*] Fixed a bug where we cannot use cards when launching the phase 2 of the Dunestalker battle.
[*] Fixed a bug where Blessing of the Underworld wasn't healing the Gallu for the correct amount.
[*] If the player has 0 Gold, the Golden Touch affix particle will not trigger anymore.
[*] Fixed a bug where Hand of Destiny was also giving out Common cards.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Curses description wasn't clear when hovering over it on the Leaderboard.
[*] Fixed a bug where Commendation of Power could sometimes attempt to upgrade a Neutral card.
[*] Fixed a bug where the enemy could have no target after being freed from Titan's Dream stasis effect.
[*] Fixed a bug where using Pyrokinesis while having no runes would create a Burn debuff without stacks.
[*] Fixed a bug where after defeat, the random encounters that were in the previous run would spawn again.
[*] Fixed a bug where Grand Emergence would not correctly trigger and go into negatives.
[*] Fixed a bug where Jinn of Destruction's Clash against inoffensive minion will render them unable to use their ability for the remainder of battle.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Alu's Haunt particle effect would linger on a platform after the owner of that debuff would be defeated.
[*] The algorithm for rarity in rewards will now be properly reset after a run.
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 is out!
notes.content:
We've been tirelessly working for the past few months to release patch 1.1.0, our biggest update yet.

There are tons of new features that are mentioned in the patch notes such as:

[list]
[*] The Introduction of the new Area, with the King of Vengeance as its leader. A new mini bosses and multiple new encounters and what we're also very much excited about, the first Elite enemy of the game: The Dunestalker. A very interesting, tough fight but totally optional for extra rewards.
[*] New and fun cards.
[*] A much more robust tutorial.
[*] The Introduction of a post-defeat Hub where the player will get to choose between multiple different fun perks for the next run. This massively changed the way we are playing the game!
[*] Massive UI improvement.
[*] Enhanced performance and a massive reduction in loading times.
[*] Reskin of a lot of NPC and enemies, and most importantly, reskin of the main characters.
[*] Complete card rework, we made sure to make them look better and much easier to read on smaller monitors.
[*] Support for 2k and 4k resolution.
[*] General bug fixes.

[/list]


There are also many smaller features that you will probably notice. Our two highest priorities were to stick to our roadmap that we have previously established and to answer a lot of player feedback and concerns.

We will keep on working to always make the game better and your feedback was our number one motivator!

The next step would be to keep following the roadmap and post regular rolling updates.

Enjoy the game!

Happy new year everyone!

notes.title: NEW Developer Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We feel that it's a good time to share what we have been working on and how things are looking for the next major update in December.

We firstly want to thank everyone for great amount of feedback that we've been getting and this is really helping us shape Desert Revenant for the better!
We will keep pushing minor patches and hotfixes until 1.1.0 is ready mainly for bug fixing, game balance and quality of life / performance updates.

[b]What we are currently working on:[/b]


[h3]Performance[/h3]

We're working on improving the performance of the game as a whole when playing on low-end PCs and also reducing the "in-game" loading screen time.
We're also trying to make sure that patching Desert Revenant becomes faster overall.
These performance updates will be rolled throughout multiple patches to make sure that the game gradually performs better and better and especially on lower end PCs.
We are hoping that the entire performance will become substantially better by 1.1.0. And this work will obviously continue after 1.1.0.


[h3]New Player Experience[/h3]

We're adding a much more robust tutorial to Desert Revenant, to make sure that the game feels more impactful at the beginning and will really help new players settle into the game. This will also help players get more in tune with the Lore of the game from the get go. Expect to also see improvements for the experience as a whole from the beginning till Victory or defeat before jumping into another run!


[h3]User Interface / User Experience[/h3]

Great improvements are expected for the UI and the UX in general. We felt that there are more details that we can focus on to make many elements more clear and visible to players. We've already started to test some more improvements in battle and we're hoping that this will make tracking spells much better since the game is quite spell heavy and has tons of status effects!


[h3]Arena of Vengeance[/h3]

New content of course! The major update will be the addition of an entire new map (Will be the third map so far).  It will also be the first time where you can expect an optional Elite battle with plenty of awesome rewards! 
There will obviously be new NPCs that will be able to offer their unique powerful cards, and many Storylines to enjoy and learn more about Elmyr.
Get ready for more challenging enemies and very engaging battles! We're currently making sure that the encounters are fun and unique, we definitely do not want repetitive combat / strategies implemented into the game so we're doing our best to make each encounter fun and unique.



So far, the progress has been great and we can't wait to release this major update in December!
We'll make sure to drop more Dev updates and also Stream more often.

We hope that you enjoyed this Developer update and thank you for reading it!

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been two weeks since our Early Access release and before we get into things, we'd really like to thank you all for your constant and crucial feedback , it's been really helping us put things into perspective and analyze the parts that we can improve in the game! 
We're extremely happy that many of you have found the game very fun to play, and we'd like to tell you that a lot more content is coming to Desert Revenant.

[h1] Overview [/h1]

We have gathered an immense amount of feedback, and have been hard at work addressing it. The most pressing matters that we are going to tackle first during these few weeks are the following:

[list]
[*] Improve the performance (Mostly GPU) of the game on lower-end PCs and reduce the overall patching size.
[*] Bug fixing.
[*] Improve the general quality of life of the game by undergoing some balance changes, and maybe giving the players a little bit more leeway to customize the decks and/or reduce the amount of time needed to unlock the new cards and curses.
[*] General UI and UX improvements (In and outside battle). We felt that it might have been a bit complex to keep up with all of the different elements in the game, and improving the UI will generally fix this situation.
[/list]


[h1] Current Content [/h1]

Desert Revenant offers quite a bit of content at the moment and our goal of course, is to keep adding to it. 
So far, there are 2 Revenants to choose from, and there are 2 completely different playable areas. Each area has its unique Boss, Mini Boss, special enemies, storylines and encounters. The game greatly changes once hopping from one area to another.
Each Revenant has a Deck of 70 cards with 61 cards already unlocked when starting the game for the first time. There are 9 very good cards to unlock for each Revenant. The way to unlock the rest of the cards is by amassing points (Score) during runs, thus eventually, making all cards usable.

Curses are also a very interesting part of the game that some players have started to recently experience. Each curse basically adds a negative modifier to your run (Tied to a save slot) to make it even harder. Adding a curse will also increase the Score that you can get at the end of your run (By adding a multiplier to the Score for each chosen curse.)
The curses add a totally different dimension to the game, to the extent that a curse like the Realm Rippers for example, adds an enemy that cannot be unlocked unless the curse is active.

The rest of the content is not gated behind score, and everything is available for players immediately by playing their first ever run.
As you may all have noticed, the game relies heavily on decision making by offering multiple rewards paths such as the Wish Jinn, Merchant, Talents, Gold Coins, Dialogues and Reputation.

Building your Deck from the wide array of available cards, coupled with different talents and blessing from Wish Jinn (Powerful buffs that remain on your character for the remainder of the run) and gathering different perks from the Reputation tree is what really create a sense of uniqueness in each run.

The Reputation is unique in a way is that it is a form Meta progression in your run (Per save slot). They are basically trees where you can pick perks that will stick with you even after death and onto your subsequent run!

We will be working on adding even more rewards during the run to add further uniqueness to each run.

Another element that is prominent in Desert Revenant right now is the presence of various affixes which are environmental modifiers that take place during certain battles. They will usually be presented on the map in between 2 nodes and they can usually tip the scales in any fight. They can either affect the player's faction (Allies), or the enemy faction or even both at the same time. Some of these include Infectious Toxins for example where healing will be rendered almost impossible during battle, or inversely, Soothing currents, where all characters in the battlefield which actually heal in the beginning of their turn.

We're already working on increase the variety of affixes present in the game to make for some more interesting player choices when it comes to pathing.



[h1] Challenges [/h1]

The main complexity of Desert Revenant stems from the huge variety of status effects (250+ and counting!) which is quite uncommon in turn based games. This creates for much more dynamic gameplay than the usual turn based or CCG games, because traditionally,  the prevalence of buffs and debuffs isn't really highlighted in such games. 
Introducing this comes with its own set of design challenges because it opens up much more doors to a plethora of different combinations. However, we found that it adds a lot of dynamism that players who invest time in the game tend to enjoy!

Another very important side of the general gameplay in battles is using minions. We're big fans of characters in RPGs having their own minions. Summoner classes are always an intriguing part of many RPGs (Video games and tabletop) but minions are for the most part not given a lot importance in traditional RPGs as they're mostly niche spells with long cooldowns.
We decided to take a little bit of a risk there and have them become an integral part of the game, and by doing so, we had to make sure that they synergize properly with each character, and also it has lead us to draw out a more complex approach to enemy AI. All enemies have different and unique ways of thinking, and they choose their spells and targets based on the state of who they are facing at the time.
Having multiple minions also lead us to adopt our intent system where we only inform the players about who's being targeted.  We preferred to go with a method without showing the exact damage that enemies will deal since there are multiple ways to mitigate damage (Healing, permanent armor, absorption shields, minions for example) and let the players decide for themselves how to counter each enemy depending on the situation they find themselves in (There are multiple factors that come into play).

Our goal is to go even deeper when it comes to combat mechanics, make sure they're not frustrating to play around and of course add more and more variety and interesting mechanics (We're always looking to add more fun minions to play with and fun status effects to play around). 
To achieve this goal, we're already designing new fun battles to play and of course new cards!




[h1] What's coming next [/h1]

We previously mentioned in this update the most pressing issues that we are working on at the moment. However, we've already started for a while working on the new upcoming content for the game.
We are happy to introduce the King of Vengeance ! The third Jinn King that is coming to Desert Revenant in December! Without spoiling much, we're going to add a little bit of information about this enemy along the way. Check out the small visual hint of this character in the header of this Dev update!

Adding a new Jinn King means adding an entirely new map, with new enemy encounters and a new Mini Boss fight, new NPCs (With every NPC having their own NPC card), new Storylines, and much more. Some of the new enemies will have their own unique mechanics will which will make the fights also extremely interesting.
This will be our first major patch since our Early Access release with tons of new content added for you to enjoy.

We've also been getting some questions about the third playable Revenant and we're happy to tell you that the development of this character has already started. We will not spoil it right now, but we can safely tell you that the playstyle of this Revenant will be massively different from the two existing ones. We're going for some extremely unique mechanics as well that are quite unusual for Deckbuilders!



We hope that you have enjoyed this update, and be sure that we will keep posting more of these regularly to inform you about the state of the game.
Also, keep an eye on our Developer streams that are going to do regularly when time permits. (We're also going to upload some excerpts of the Streams on our official [b]Kreationware [/b]Youtube channel)
Thanks again for your feedback, do not ever hesitate to send us even more, we're happy to address all of it and keep on improving the game to offer you the best possible experience.



Thank you,
The Kreationware team

notes.title: DESERT REVENANT DEV DIARY #1 - Introduction
notes.content:
[b]DESERT REVENANT[/b]
How it all started, and where it’s all going.

Welcome Revenant,

We’re excited to announce that our game Desert Revenant is currently being prepared for full release. In this blog, we will be sharing with you updates about the game, the progress we’ve made so far, and an inside look behind the scenes. So blow the dust off your cards and join us as we make our way across the sands of Elmyr. 



[b]Small Beginnings[/b]
What started as a small game with the code name Project Eremus developed into a much bigger, more ambitious project. We initially aimed for a dungeon crawler, with a very short story and high replayability. However with time, we’ve come to that having a rich story would enhance the experience, and we love a good story. The game went through a lot of changes but the core essence remains: An exciting and challenging adventure in an ancient Arabian world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/d56c6a54158af43559b836927163582011f77ddb.jpg[/img]
The first poster we hung at our studio. Good(?) times.



[b]The Story[/b]
The story we’ve been building was always set somewhere in an ancient Arabian world, this later became known as Elmyr. We’ve been interested in diving deeply into Arabian folklore, so you’ll notice that most of what you’ll see in our world is heavily inspired by it. Jinns are also a big inspiration for us, the Jinn Kings play a huge role in the story as you’ll find out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/b9d63930f54d23e7a6186b8c35940d3b3761d244.jpg[/img]


[b]The Art Direction[/b]
There’s a certain charm to hand-drawn and painted art that we knew from the beginning would be how we wanted our game to feel. We’ve been inspired by many 2D games and ancient paintings and we believe that this art direction we took can last for ages. We set off with mood boards that reflect what we wanted our world to be like and the characters we created were a mix of ancient myths and legends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/ff8f248fae1100e22ad3ef9338f95e46ad100e75.jpg[/img]
The area of the Sun King: The Temple Of The Sun


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/954b925c2eb2fa9866ab01fdced5b05e103e1661.png[/img]
Early sketches of the Leper


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/132703257b3f2ff94afa7f96aa7d1245c5053f3a.gif[/img]
Timelapse of the environment being created for a level in the Temple of the Sun area



[b]The Gameplay[/b]
We love a good challenge, to think and strategize before making a move leads to a much more satisfying win. We also wanted a fun deck builder, the cards we created needed to have good synergy so that combining them to defeat the enemies was as fun as possible. By later adding rogue-like elements and a story that fits this playstyle, we made replayability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/6e7993c2f61ff0d7041cfa79c2f550c3d9a97eb4.png[/img]
Summons are your best friends. Don’t get too attached though… 



[b]Closed Alpha[/b]
We created a closed alpha for players to test the game with only the Leper as a playable character. We’ve gathered a lot of feedback concerning the gameplay that we worked on improving for a better Early Access. Our community grew our Discord server, the game was well-received. From the statistics we gathered, only a few percent of players were able to win the run against the Sun King. In a way, we feel that this is good because the game is difficult enough to challenge the players, but on the other hand, we’re hoping to make the game more user-friendly so that it’s easier for players to understand. We believe the UI needs to be improved to help new players get the hang of the game faster. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/1345d091b561786cebf1fe4b11b4c0f57d140dde.jpg[/img]


[b]Trailer/First Announcement[/b]
[previewyoutube=8CncgXi_eAI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Demo Update[/b]
[list]
[*] New Character (The Seer)
[*] New Dialogues
[*] New cards
[*] War Stories
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Quality of life improvements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/19c8eef89292022defe05ec80c07bb48dea3c1de.png[/img]
You can now play as The Seer


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/3fc98e5fa401112d81a27022dcabe1e51a9e4d4c.jpg[/img]
New war story sketches


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/d20b525b81280bd66674fcfbeb51c92b3770e004.png[/img]
New dialogue scenes


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/30a20e7952252928c184e001114ae1ac4cb1d297.jpg[/img]
New characters


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/e76d24086950cb9b787f28254639ff7e819d6af5.gif[/img]
New animations



[b]Early Access[/b]
We’re aiming on releasing an additional map to play on for the Early Access at the end of July 2022. The new map will include new characters as well as new levels and a new boss fight. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/82b3df78637ad34a8e12700c77c2b955493d7781.jpg[/img]
New battle room in Area 2



[b]Full Release[/b]
For the full release, we’re aiming on having 6 maps total. Each map will have new levels and environments that are completely different. We’ll also have new non-player characters and enemies as well as new Revenants for the player to choose from. There will be a more expansive playthrough by giving the player the ability to start from any map in any order. Each playthrough will be different and each death will be connected to the previous run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316585/e89b6df3bbb95f79acf35c020a3c9e8290569ac6.jpg[/img]



Thanks for your support and we hope you enjoy our game,

The Kreationware team.
